actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: AirSimEnv is the Gym environment class a user instantiates; it derives from gym.Env and uses gym spaces
The observation space is a Box with low 0, high 255 and shape (30, 100); the state starts as uint8 zeros of the same shape
The action space is Discrete(3)
The flight goal is global xy (221.0, -9.0)
The distance log starts at 221 and the track log at -2 for every episode
The environment uses the legacy Gym methods _step and _reset, not the current Gymnasium reset/step API
A step asserts the action is in the action space, forwards it to airgym.take_action, then reads getPosition and goal_direction
The distance reward is -1 plus the distance closed since the previous step (distance_before - distance_now)
A collision ends the episode with reward -100; the code also ends it with reward 0 when take_action returns 99
Reaching within 3 of the goal ends the episode with reward 100
A cumulative reward below -100 ends the episode
A step returns the depth observation, reward, done and an info object with x_pos and y_pos
A reset calls AirSim_reset, clears the logs and returns the depth observation
The depth observation is 10 goal-direction rows on top of 20 depth rows, 100 columns wide, and the goal line is mapped from track over -180..180 onto 0..100
The depth image comes from AirSim's DepthPerspective camera, inverted and gamma-corrected with factor 10 before resizing
Action 0 flies straight for 1 s at 4 m/s, action 1 yaws right for 0.8 s, action 2 yaws left for 1 s
straight moves along the current heading at the requested speed with moveByVelocityZ at z=-6
yaw_right commands 30 deg/s and yaw_left commands -30 deg/s
The README documents the three actions as straight 4 m/s for 1 s, right yaw 26 deg/s for 1 s and left yaw 30 deg/s for 1 s
MultirotorClient defaults the AirSim address to 127.0.0.1 and passes port 41451 to AirSimClientBase
AirSimClientBase opens a msgpackrpc Client to that address and port
The README says the repository is not maintained anymore and new AirSim versions are very likely incompatible
The Gym registration of AirSimEnv-v42 is commented out; the module only imports register

determinism.notes: on the fake backend, reset(seed) selects the placeholder depth texture, so one seed and action sequence repeats a trajectory; the upstream AirGym._seed only initialises np_random (AirGym.py:41-49) and no code reads it, so the real AirSim simulation is not driven by this seed.  The fake is the only backend that was run

gaps: kinematic/analytic stand-in only: it integrates straight motion at 4 m/s and yaw at 30 deg/s for the durations of myAirSimClient.py:70-102; it models no AirSim physics, no contact, no actuator, no sensor or noise model and no obstacle
no collision: take_action never reports has_collided, while the upstream polls getCollisionInfo() during every action (myAirSimClient.py:74-99); collision termination is therefore not exercised

the 30 x 100 observation is a placeholder image: 10 goal-direction rows over 20 synthetic depth rows (the shape of myAirSimClient.py:141-153), not AirSim's DepthPerspective camera image; the depth rows are a fixed per-episode texture and do not change as the drone moves, while only the goal-direction line follows the yaw
the reset options object is accepted by the bridge and ignored, because AirSimEnv._reset takes no arguments (AirGym.py:127); only the seed affects the fake
the seed only drives the fake's placeholder depth texture; the real AirSim simulation is external and was never started, so the upstream environment was not compared with this fake
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and the fake does not reproduce the time.sleep and blocking waits of myAirSimClient.py:54-102 and :161-169
snapshot and restore are not offered: AirSimEnv exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses every step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
